correctness.rationale: Fresh derivation confirms the boundary law. Yeo's standard-teleportation criterion is sinh x>cosh(ηx); equality rearranges exactly to tanh((1−η)x/2)=exp(−(1+η)x), with a unique positive root because the two sides are strictly increasing/decreasing. Setting δ=1−η, u=δx/2 and κ=(1+η)/δ gives \(\tanh u=e^{-2\kappa u}\). As κ→∞, u→0, so \(2\kappa u\,e^{2\kappa u}=2\kappa(1+o(1))\) and (1+η)x~W(2κ). Substituting the equality into the source concurrence yields \(C_r=\frac12-e^{-x}-\frac12e^{-2x}\). Since \(e^{-(1+\eta)x}\sim \delta(1+\eta)x/4\) and \(\delta(1+\eta)x\to0\), the concurrence gap has the claimed (1/2)sqrt(δ W(4/δ)) scale. Independent numerical roots at η=.9,.99,.999,.9999 show the temperature asymptotic ratio tending to 1 (about 1.000446, 1.0000077, 1.00000012, 1.000000002) and the gap ratio tending to 1.
